response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM s), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE s.a > b.base), qm AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS qmean FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.a AS avg_modelconf, q.a - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.a / qm.qmean AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN b CROSS JOIN qm WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND qm.qmean IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A status group whose modelconf values are all NULL has a NULL average. It is left out of the baseline mean, because AVG ignores NULLs, and it cannot qualify as above the baseline.
Cases with a NULL brokrepstat form one group, and that group counts once in the baseline like any other status.
